discovery: Cosmic inflation and the quantum origin of the primordial density fluctuations that seeded cosmic structure
motivation: Guth proposed that an early epoch of accelerated expansion solves the horizon and flatness problems; Linde developed the new and chaotic inflation scenarios that made the idea physically viable. Mukhanov (with Chibisov) showed that quantum vacuum fluctuations, stretched by accelerated expansion, generate nearly scale-invariant, adiabatic, Gaussian curvature perturbations with a small red tilt. These predictions have since been confirmed with remarkable precision by CMB observations: WMAP and Planck measured acoustic peaks consistent with purely adiabatic, coherent super-horizon initial conditions, negligible non-Gaussianity, spatial flatness, and a spectral index n_s ≈ 0.965, departing from exact scale invariance at over eight standard deviations, exactly as predicted. Combined BICEP/Keck-Planck B-mode limits now sharply test specific models. The theory transformed our understanding of the origin of all cosmic structure as quantum in nature, and is a well-tested, predictive framework.
